item.title: [Lanka Leader] Electricity tariffs could drop by 10% as rain boosts hydropower, says ECA
item.description: Electricity tariffs could fall by at least 10% in the final quarter of 2026 instead of rising, the Electricity Consumers’ Association (ECA) said, citing a surge in hydropower generation after heavy rain.
